_note: D58/D62: the shipped and manual list of names and terms the language layer NEVER translates (masked before translation, restored after). Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive. Nobody needs to edit this file for the owner's or his family's names: JARVIS learns them from conversation into names.json in the data folder and merges both; a term listed here always wins. Say 'never translate <word>' to add one.
